item.title: Concluding Remarks
item.lead: This concluding page summarizes the editorial stance without presenting the source claims as independently verified facts.

items: The core of the dossier is a systemic critique of the commodification of human proximity.
The most useful next step is evidence-based reconstruction, not further rhetorical escalation.
Digital sovereignty requires transparency, control over data, and factual accountability throughout the entire chain.
Human dignity remains the normative benchmark in this synthesis, while empirical claims must be tested separately.

blocks.label: SOURCE STATUS
blocks.text: Based on the concluding chapters, model legislation, post-digital recovery strategy, and the substantive synthesis of the submitted dossier. The formulation of recommendations is an editorial ordering of the source material. This Research Edition 4.0 adds current public source verification as of September 19, 2026, and explicitly marks which figures/claims from the source material have not been independently verified.

Guide for further research. The source itself mentions legal documentation, technical data, and sociological analysis as three tracks for triangulation. In this edition, these tracks have been brought together as an editorial structure; they have not been externally verified.
